decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's dumper range, it likely uses existing engineering, sales and service resources, so the option remains cheap to keep open absent clear negative evidence.
This articulated dumper stays close to the core customer base and, in a growing machinery market, a German Mittelstand producer would usually give such an adjacent product more time before exit.

The mine rescue vehicle serves a narrower and more uncertain niche outside the main range, so withdrawal risk is materially higher, but the firm would still preserve the option while outcomes in this specialized market remain only partly revealed.
A telescopic loader line with several models signals broader commitment and capability reuse, making continued offering relatively low cost compared with the value of learning and market presence.
The reported large order and evidence of strong rental-market acceptance make this close-to-core material-lift line look validated, so there is little reason to abandon it.
Although still somewhat distant from the established range, the machine's heavy early use provides strong technical and customer validation, which raises the value of continuing the option.
